usedFor: Amazon Seller Central is where orders land, and Razorpay is where “Create Invoice” bills the customer for each one.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Amazon Seller Central, then “Create Invoice” in Razorpay
bestTemplate.why: You can narrow “New Order Created” by marketplace and status, so only the orders you invoice start the action.

watchOut: “New Order Created” is polling, so “Create Invoice” runs after a scheduled check, not at the moment of the order.
